eta: [ sabbanāmapuda.] (ti) CL=7 [Etada (saṃ)] (1) this. (this man, this woman, this mind, this race, this thing, etc.,). (2) This. That. (3) That.
[ ima mha proṅaḥlāsopuda ] (ti) CL=7 See - Etarahi.
etabba: [ i + tabba ] (ti) CL=7 Should be reached and known.
etadagga: [ anukaraṇaja nāmapuda.]  CL=9 This is the 'anukaraṇaja' noun arisen due to the Buddha"s words 'Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave”. (A) the position of Etadagga/ those who are foremost,  that position, that title. a special title put by the word 'etadagga'.) (2) the Etadagga Sutta. (3) the Etadagga Vagga. (4) the etadagga dhamma, etadagga.
[ etadagga + sutta ] (na) CL=7 Etadagga-sutta. See - Eta 2.
[ etadagga + ṭhapana ] (na) CL=7 Places the highest or best. See - Etadagga 1 (2).

[ etaṃ aggaṃ ]  CL=9 (A) This person (this monk, this nun, this male lay person, this female lay person, this donations, etc.) is the most excellent. (This is the title, thing, and quality uttered by the Buddha.) (B) This is the noblest- the most excellent. (This is what is talked by a certain person as he thinks so.)”
etadaggabhāva: [ etadagga + bhāva ] (pu) CL=7 As the highest state or a state of etadagga.

etadaggappatta: [ etadagga + patta ] (ti) CL=7 One who attains the state of etadagga.
etadaggapāḷi: [ etadagga + pāḷi ] (thī) CL=7 The Etadagga pāḷi.

etadaggasuttapada: [ etadaggasutta + pada ] (na) CL=7 Etadagga sutta pāḷi.
etadaggavaggavaṇṇanā: [ etadaggavagga + vaṇṇanā ] (thī) CL=7 The commentary of etadagga vagga.
etadaggaṃ: [ etaṃ aggaṃ ]  CL=9 (A) This person (this monk, this nun, this male lay person, this female lay person, this donations, etc.) is the most excellent. (This is the title, thing, and quality uttered by the Buddha.) (B) This is the noblest- the most excellent. (This is what is talked by a certain person as he thinks so.)”
etadaggaṭṭhapana: [ etadagga + ṭhapana  ] (na) CL=7 Places the highest or best. See - Etadagga 1 (2).
etadaggaṭṭhapita: [ etadagga + ṭhapita ] (ti) CL=7 One who should be placed in the highest place.
etadaggaṭṭhāna: [ etadagga + ṭhāna ] (na)  CL=7 The place of Etadagga. The position of Etadagga.
etadaggaṭṭhānanthara: [ etadagga + ṭhānantara ] (na) CL=7 The position of etadagga. The title of etadagga.
etadantha: [ eta + antha ] (ti) CL=7 The end that is removing this (danger for Vipassanā).
etadanthika: [ eta + anta + ika ] (ti) CL=7 The end that is this (arahattaphala). (If (someone) attains arahattaphala, reaches a state of cessation).
etadattha: [ eta + attha.] (pu) CL=7 [Nīti, pada. 367.] (1) This meaning. That meaning. (Ti) (2) (A) This (that)... result or benefit. Of this (that) result or benefit. Cause to give this (that) result or benefit. (B) With this (that) result or benefit. With the result or benefit that is this (that) (anupādisesaparinibbāna, arahattaphala).
etadatthaparidīpaka: [ etadattha + paridīpaka ] (pu,na) CL=7 Shows this meaning. See - Etadattha (2).
etaparimāṇa: [ eta + parimāṇa ] (na) CL=7 (1) This extent. The amount is as much as this extent. (Ti) (2)  The amount is as much as this extent.

etappamāṇa: [ eta + pamāṇa ] (ti) CL=7 The amount is such an extent.
etapparama: [ eta + parama ] (ti) CL=7 The maximum amount is such an extent. The highest amount is such an extent.
etarahi: [ ima + rahi.] (bya) CL=7 [Imasmiṃ kāleetarahi. Rū. 280. Etahiṃ (saṃ)] At present (time).
etaṃgocara: [ eta + gocara ] (ti) CL=7 One who focuses and wanders on the ājīvaṭṭhamaka precepts. See below.
etaṃparama: [ eta + parama ]  CL=9 (1) (adverb) as much as this. as much as this practice. (mfn). having just this as the noblest, as far as this, as much as this in maximum.
etaṃparamaetaparamaetapparama: [ eta + parama ]  CL=9 (1) (adv) This much, as much as, as much as this practice. (mfn) (2) having this as the highest; as long as this, as many- much as this.. At most - so much - this amount. (as much - long as this. Sammo, yo.)
etaṃpariyosāna: [ eta + pariyosāna ] (ti) CL=7 The end of this result or benefit. See - Etaṃpatha.
etaṃpatha: [ eta + patha ] (ti) CL=7 One who has a cause of knowing or understanding path that is ājīvaṭṭhamaka precepts. (One who has the ājīvaṭṭhamaka precepts that is a cause of knowing him by others).
etaṃsāra: [ eta + sāra ] (ti) CL=7 The essence that is this result or benefit.
etha: [ i + a + tha.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + a + tha.] May you (pl) come. Please you (pl) come. See - Eti (4).
eti: [ i + a + ti.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + a + ti. Nīti,dhā,3. Etisaddo yattha ce iriyā-pathavācako, tattha āgamanaṃyeva jo-teti, na gamanaṃ. Nīti,dhā,7. Ā iti. Nīti,sutta.nhā.23.] (1) He reaches. (2) He becomes. He establishes. (3) He knows. (4) He comes. He comes or rises. (5) He prospers. (6) He enters. He approaches. He reveres. (7) He always follows.
etta: [ eta + ttaka.] (ti) CL=7 The amount is such extent.
ettaka: [ eta + ttaka.] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī ettakā, ettikā. Moga,4.42. Rū,nhā. 234. Iya-ttaka (saṃ)] (1) About such extent. (nīti, pada.) The amount that is as much as such extent. (vimati.) (2) One who has this name.
ettakaguṇa: [ ettaka + guṇa ] (ti) CL=7 The quality that is as high as this extent.
ettakajana: [ ettaka + jana ] (pu) CL=7 That number of people.
ettakamatta: [ ettaka + matta ] (ti) CL=7 (A Bhikkhu) who has those years of monkhood.
ettakapadesa: [ ettaka + padesa ] (pu) CL=7 The region or place that is as wide as this extent.
ettakaparama: [ ettaka + parama ] (ti) CL=7 One who is the superior or highest state.
ettakapañña: [ ettakā + paññā ] (ti) CL=7 The intelligence that is as high as this extent.
ettakappamāṇa: [ ettaka + pamāṇa ] (ti) CL=7 The amount that is as much as this extent. See - Ettaka (1).
ettakasamādhi: [ ettaka + samādhi ] (ti) CL=7 One who has that state of samādhi. See - Ettakapañña.
ettakasīla: [ ettaka + sīla ] (ti) CL=7 One who has that extent of sīla. See - Ettakapañña.
ettakaukkaṃsakoṭika: [ ettaka + ukkaṃsakoṭi + ka ] (ti) CL=7 One who is superior or highest. See - Ettakaparama.
ettakāpātha: [ ettaka + āpātha ] (pu) CL=7 One who appears this sense object in the mind. See - Etaṃpatha.
ettha: [ i + tha ]  CL=7 Arrived or reached. See - Edhati 1 (3).

[ eta + tha.] (bya) CL=7 [Kaccaññaḥ. 233. Rū. 264. Atra (saṃ)] (1) In this (dhamma, situation, place, etc.,). (2) In that (doctrine, etc.,). (3) That (decision, etc.,). (4) This (words (sound), etc.,).
etthagedha: [ ettha + pavatta + gedha ] (ti) CL=7 One who strongly attaches to this (elephant forest).
etthanthara: [ ettha + antara ] (na) CL=7 This interval or the space between or in this place.
etthapadaniddesa: [ ekatthapada +niddesa ] (pu) CL=7 Analytical description that explains the words that have the same meaning.
etthāvacara: [ ettha + ava + cara + ṇa ] (ti) CL=7 Wandering in (this realm or region).
ettikā: [ eta + ttaka + ā (itthī paccaññaḥ)] (thī) CL=7 With this extent or such extent. See - Ettaka.
etto: [ eta + to.] (bya) CL=7 [Kaccaññaḥ. 233. Rū. 264. Moga,4.96.] (1) From this (region, realm, etc.,). (2) From that (region, realm, etc.,).
ettāvanthu: [ eta + tāvantu.] (ti) CL=7 [Rū.384. Eta + āvantu. Moga,4.43. Eta+ṭāvantu. Nirutti. 489. ] The amount that is as much as this extent or to this extent.
ettāvatā: [ nipātapuda.] (bya) CL=7 [Rū,nhā.134. Nīti,suttha,nhā.383. Dhāna. 1141.] To this extent. Only to this extent. By the sequence of such an amount of (saddā).
etu: [ i + a + tu.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + a + tū. ] May he come. Please come. See - Eti (4).
[ i + tuṃ ] (bya) CL=7 To arrive. See - Etave.
etuṃ: [ i + tuṃ ] (bya) CL=7 To arrive. See - Etave.
etādisa: [ eta + dusa + kvi.] (ti) CL=7 [Kaccaññaḥ, nyāsa.642. Nīti, sutta. 1269. Eta+disa+kvi. Rū.588. Eta+disa+ka. Moga,5. 43. In Thī etādisī. (etādas (saṃ)] Should concentrate and contemplate such as this. One who has this nature.
etādisikā: [ etādisa + ika + ā (itthīpaccaññaḥ)]  CL=9 Such, such-like.
etādisī: [ eta + dusa + kvi + ī (itthīpaccaññaḥ.) eta + disa + kvi +ī (itthīpaccaññaḥ.) eta + disa + ka + ī (itthīpaccaññaḥ.) ] (thī) CL=7 Should concentrate and contemplate such as this. One who has this nature. See - Etādisa.
etāparamatā: [(eta + parama=) etāparama + tā ] (thī) CL=7 The dhamma that is superior.
etāpāta: [ eta + āpātha ] (ti) CL=7 One who appears in the wisdom as the sense object that is this (ājīvaṭṭhamakasīla). One who appears to that extent in the wisdom.
etāvaparama: [ eta + eva + parama.] (ti) CL=7 [Eso eva paramo etassāti etāvaparamo.nīti,sutta.nhā.211. Nīti, pada.nhā.36.] One who has this dhamma that is superior and incomparable.
etagocara: [ eta + gocara ] (ti) CL=7 One who focuses and wanders on the ājīvaṭṭhamaka precepts. See below.
etaparama: [ eta + parama ]  CL=9 (1) (adverb) as much as this. as much as this practice. (mfn). having just this as the noblest, as far as this, as much as this in maximum.
etaparamaetaparamaetapparama: [ eta + parama ]  CL=9 (1) (adv) This much, as much as, as much as this practice. (mfn) (2) having this as the highest; as long as this, as many- much as this.. At most - so much - this amount. (as much - long as this. Sammo, yo.)
etapariyosāna: [ eta + pariyosāna ] (ti) CL=7 The end of this result or benefit. See - Etaṃpatha.
etapatha: [ eta + patha ] (ti) CL=7 One who has a cause of knowing or understanding path that is ājīvaṭṭhamaka precepts. (One who has the ājīvaṭṭhamaka precepts that is a cause of knowing him by others).
etasāra: [ eta + sāra ] (ti) CL=7 The essence that is this result or benefit.
ettakaukkasakoṭika: [ ettaka + ukkaṃsakoṭi + ka ] (ti) CL=7 One who is superior or highest. See - Ettakaparama.
